body:
I've never experimented with RCs before this.  I was referred to a known and trusted source.  I originally wanted to get 4-FA, but my only options were 2-FA and Ethylphenidate.  The 2-FA was sold out, so I decided to go with Ethylphenidate.
There wasn't a lot of information on this substance out there.  It is related to Ritalin (Methylphenidate), and that it is a reportedly clean stimulant compared to amphetamines.
My original plan was to dilute a gram into a nasal spray.  Things didn't quite work out, however, so I decided I would just eat the crystal raw.  I did not have a miligram scale.  I read that a small amount - 10-25mgs - was needed to produce minimal effects.
I licked my index finger and retrieved a few crystals.  I licked the product and swallowed.  It's a nasty, bitter taste.  The tip of my tongue is numbed.  About ten minutes later I feel uplifted and a little anxious.
The effects peaked after about thirty minutes.  I could feel a small rushing energy coursing through my body.  It is a light euphoria, more similar to cocaine than amphetamines.  I am able to concentrate better, but it is not as effective as dextro-amphetamine.
Unlike amphetamines, there is no jaw tension.  My appetite is reduced but I can still eat a full meal comfortably.  Writing is easy.  I can move a little faster and get things done a little quicker.  I take my dog out for a walk, but I run out of breath much quickly than usual.  Physical activity sucks.
I feel the effects for about two and a half hours, and I feel the buzz tapering off. After the three hour mark, I begin to feel a crash.
After the three hour mark, I begin to feel a crash.
Four hours and I am completely down.  I feel slightly irritable.  My hands and feet are very cold.  I can't concentrate worth a shit.  I have my browser open with three tabs, and I'm jumping in between each one rapidly.  I can't focus on a task for more than four minutes.
I am having trouble sleeping eight hours later.  My chest is tight, I am anxious, and I am restless.  After drinking two cups of chamomile tea, I no longer feel the crashing effects.
Overall, I did not like this chemical.  It was not worth experiencing two hours of euphoria just to crash for six hours.
